name: fable-video-maker
task: Use the fable-video-maker skill to make a 20-second vertical film in the 'painted' look: an old lighthouse keeper climbs the tower one last time at dusk and lights the lamp for a ship he will never see. Music only, no voice and no ElevenLabs (build the score in code as the quiet-blade example does). The skill is installed at ./.claude/skills/fable-video-maker; KIT is its kit folder there. Do the setup yourself and keep node_modules, downloads and the film inside this folder; don't install anything into the home folder. Treat this message as the agreed brief and script approval: don't ask me questions, run unattended, render when the stills pass. Put the finished video at ./films/<name>/out/film.mp4 and run the skill's verify step. Don't delete or change anything outside this folder. If something can't be done, say exactly what and why. Answer in English.
